Remarks

This sender broadcasts messages to all connected clients using a method name pattern of "Consume_{TypeName}". Clients must register a handler for this method name to receive messages.

Remarks

The message is sent using the method name "Consume_{TypeName}" where {TypeName} is the name of type T. All connected clients that have registered a handler for this method will receive the message.
